public_rationale: Reporting explicitly identifies Claude as the sole available model before the post, while OpenAI announced a competing classified-use agreement before publication. The result could change under an authorization-only reading of available.

statement.excerpt: Just as a note: Anthropic is also the only AI model that appears to be available for classified military operations.
statement.document_title: The AI Bubble Is An Information War

our_interpretation: Anthropic refers to its Claude model family.
The context concerns publicly known general-purpose frontier models in U.S. military classified systems, not every specialized military AI system worldwide.
Available ordinarily means operationally accessible in those systems. An agreement to deploy a model does not necessarily establish operational availability.
This is an ongoing state without a reporting period. Use March 2, 2026, the last completed calendar day before the post, as the historical snapshot.
Appears limits the claim to what the public record reasonably indicated.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that Claude was operationally available in U.S. classified military systems during the target period and was the only publicly known frontier model available there.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence identifies another frontier model operationally available in the same classified military setting during the target period.
